display.title: Episode 131: The Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 3
display.summary_short: A lost child knocks on Avraham and Sarah's door in a blizzard, setting Hashem's plan in motion; plus a visit from the musician and nature teacher Reb Nature.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi opens by explaining that the program's goal is to unite Jewish children through Torah and mitzvos, then leads the Hakochainik march and a sponsor message. Story time recalls the Baal Shem Tov's visit to Avraham and Sarah's wedding, where his ten students gave gifts that all belonged to wealthy poritzim. After a young member of the Tzivos Hashem club leads the Shema, the chapter continues. Three months later the couple live in a cottage near Reuven's hotel. On a wild winter night a small, shivering boy knocks on their door: he was lost in the forest while riding with a servant from his family's mansion. They warm him by the fire, wrap him in blankets and put him to bed, planning to bring him home when the storm passes. Next week, Uncle Yossi promises, we will see how Hashem arranged all this to reward their kindness. The mailbox brings a mother's letter and an invitation for children to talk with Uncle Yossi by phone. Then Reb Nature, a camp counselor and musician, talks about his records on the Twelve Pesukim and Eretz Yisroel, does some character voices, and invites everyone to the Tzivos Hashem Summer Experience.
display.lesson: Hashem arranges events in wondrous ways to reward kindness; welcoming someone in need can change everything.
